title: Finite-stage compatible local maps between fixed models
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder, $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a functor with Noetherian rings $R_k$, and $c$ a limit cone of $R^{\mathrm{op}}\circ\operatorname{Spec}$ with affine vertex $S$. Fix $i\in I$ and a quasi-compact, quasi-separated, locally finitely presented morphism $f:X_i\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$ [def-pc-scheme]. Put $X=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)} S$, and $X_j=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}\operatorname{Spec}(R_j)$ for $j\geq i$ [def-pc-base-change]. Fix $j\geq i$, finitely presented quasi-coherent modules $F_j,G_j$ on $X_j$ [pqf-def-coherent], and a map $\varphi:(F_j)_X\to(G_j)_X$. There are $j'\geq j$, a finite affine open cover $U$ of $X_{j'}$, and a morphism $\psi$ between the restriction descent data of $(F_j)_{j'}$ and $(G_j)_{j'}$. Write $A$ for pullback from $X_j$ to $X_{j'}$, $B$ for pullback from $X_{j'}$ to $X$, $e$ for the canonical comparison from direct pullback to $A\circ B$ [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso], $Q$ for restriction to $U$ and $Q_X$ for restriction to its pullback cover on $X$. For every global $\alpha:A F_j\to A G_j$ whose restriction datum is $\psi$, one has $Q_X(e_{F_j}\circ B(\alpha))=Q_X(\varphi\circ e_{G_j})$ componentwise on each member of the pulled-back cover (Lean composition order). This specifies compatible local maps and their recovery of $\varphi$; it does not construct $\alpha$.

proof.text: On a finite affine cover of Xi (or Xj for fixed models), identify base changes of coordinate rings with tensor products and the limit ring with their directed colimit. Apply the affine finite-presentation descent theorem to the local objects or maps. For a preorder pass to its partial-order quotient; the fixed i provides nonemptiness. Lift finite generators, relation matrices, and maps at a common later stage.

For map data, cover pairwise overlaps by finitely many affines and apply the equality clause so local lifted maps agree. Pass to one later stage for this finite collection. Form their descent-data morphism psi. On the limit cover their components agree with phi through the canonical comparison, giving the asserted equality for any alpha with components psi. Only the local maps and compatibility equations are constructed.
